Input_Data_Format.Rmd
library(colocboost)

Input Data Format

This vignette documents the required input data formats and provides examples of data included in the package.

Individual Level Data

For analyses using individual-level data, the package requires matched X and Y data. Below is the format and an example from the package:

# Load example individual-level data
data(Ind_5traits)

# Display the structure
str(Ind_5traits)
#> List of 3
#>  $ X                   :List of 5
#>   ..$ Outcome_1: num [1:1153, 1:3000] -0.148 -0.148 1.24 -0.148 1.24 ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:1153] "sample_1" "sample_2" "sample_3" "sample_4" ...
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "scaled:center")= Named num [1:3000] 1.107 0.302 0.17 0.452 1.64 ...
#>   .. .. ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "scaled:scale")= Named num [1:3000] 0.72 0.511 0.405 0.596 0.54 ...
#>   .. .. ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   ..$ Outcome_2: num [1:1153, 1:3000] -0.148 -0.148 1.24 -0.148 1.24 ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:1153] "sample_1" "sample_2" "sample_3" "sample_4" ...
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "scaled:center")= Named num [1:3000] 1.107 0.302 0.17 0.452 1.64 ...
#>   .. .. ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "scaled:scale")= Named num [1:3000] 0.72 0.511 0.405 0.596 0.54 ...
#>   .. .. ..- attr(*, "names")= chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...

#>   .. ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:1153] "sample_1" "sample_2" "sample_3" "sample_4" ...
#>   .. .. ..$ : NULL
#>   ..$ Outcome_3: num [1:1153, 1] 4.277 1.5 -0.742 -0.647 -3.336 ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:1153] "sample_1" "sample_2" "sample_3" "sample_4" ...
#>   .. .. ..$ : NULL
#>   ..$ Outcome_4: num [1:1153, 1] 0.99 1.23 2.21 1.46 2.66 ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:1153] "sample_1" "sample_2" "sample_3" "sample_4" ...
#>   .. .. ..$ : NULL
#>   ..$ Outcome_5: num [1:1153, 1] -2.862 1.829 4.641 0.317 -0.914 ...
#>   .. ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. .. ..$ : chr [1:1153] "sample_1" "sample_2" "sample_3" "sample_4" ...
#>   .. .. ..$ : NULL
#>  $ true_effect_variants:List of 5
#>   ..$ Outcome_1: num 644
#>   ..$ Outcome_2: num [1:2] 644 2289
#>   ..$ Outcome_3: num [1:2] 644 2289
#>   ..$ Outcome_4: num 644
#>   ..$ Outcome_5: num 2289

Format Requirements

  • Data should be in a data frame or matrix
  • Each row represents an individual
  • Columns must include matched genotype (X) and phenotype (Y) data
  • Missing values should be coded as NA

Summary Statistics

For analyses using summary statistics, the package requires a data frame with matched linkage disequilibrium (LD) information:

# Load example summary statistics data
data(Sumstat_5traits)

# Display the structure
str(Sumstat_5traits)
#> List of 2
#>  $ sumstat             :List of 5
#>   ..$ Outcome_1:'data.frame':    3000 obs. of  3 variables:
#>   .. ..$ z      : num [1:3000] -0.586 0.106 -1.051 -0.452 -0.684 ...
#>   .. ..$ n      : int [1:3000] 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 ...
#>   .. ..$ variant: chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   ..$ Outcome_2:'data.frame':    3000 obs. of  3 variables:
#>   .. ..$ z      : num [1:3000] 0.1723 2.294 -0.9365 -0.4862 -0.0554 ...
#>   .. ..$ n      : int [1:3000] 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 ...
#>   .. ..$ variant: chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   ..$ Outcome_3:'data.frame':    3000 obs. of  3 variables:
#>   .. ..$ z      : num [1:3000] 0.494 0.934 -0.758 -1.941 -1.434 ...
#>   .. ..$ n      : int [1:3000] 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 ...
#>   .. ..$ variant: chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   ..$ Outcome_4:'data.frame':    3000 obs. of  3 variables:
#>   .. ..$ z      : num [1:3000] 0.541 1.364 0.192 -0.533 -0.604 ...
#>   .. ..$ n      : int [1:3000] 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 ...
#>   .. ..$ variant: chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>   ..$ Outcome_5:'data.frame':    3000 obs. of  3 variables:
#>   .. ..$ z      : num [1:3000] -0.672 -0.0211 0.0486 -0.7682 -0.6641 ...
#>   .. ..$ n      : int [1:3000] 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 1153 ...
#>   .. ..$ variant: chr [1:3000] "rs_1" "rs_2" "rs_3" "rs_4" ...
#>  $ true_effect_variants:List of 5
#>   ..$ Outcome_1: num 644
#>   ..$ Outcome_2: num [1:2] 644 2289
#>   ..$ Outcome_3: num [1:2] 644 2289
#>   ..$ Outcome_4: num 644
#>   ..$ Outcome_5: num 2289

Format Requirements

  • Data should be in a data frame
  • Each row represents a variant
  • Must include effect size, standard error, and sample size information
  • LD matrix must be provided separately or calculated from the data
